ideas.pitch: A zero-config deployment preview manager tailored for fast-paced student hackathons, letting teams spin up full-stack PR environments instantly.
ideas.title: RenderSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the Render sponsor prize track by showcasing deep integration with their infrastructure and solving an immediate pain point for every team at Hackman X.

ideas.pitch: An interactive, automated code refactoring assistant that generates clean idiomatic solutions and tests using strict constraints.
ideas.title: CraftedCode
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the CodeCrafters sponsor track by focusing on low-level engineering best practices, test-driven reliability, and clean code generation.

ideas.pitch: A lightning-fast subdomain and portfolio generator powered by .xyz domains, allowing hackathon participants to showcase their 10th-anniversary projects instantly.
ideas.title: DomainDropX
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the .xyz sponsor prize track by driving immediate utility and registrations for their domain extension during the event.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data pipeline debugger that traces data corruption incidents and auto-generates verified patch pull requests.
ideas.title: AgentLineage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven architecture of a major hackathon winner while executing a polished, highly technical data-engineering demo for judges.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first emergency response and incident triage dashboard optimized for large college campuses like DSCE during events.
ideas.title: CampusSOS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a live operator cockpit and real-time triage workflow that guarantees a high-impact, working demo for the judges.
